# Interview speaker card over a synthetic presenter

The interview-speaker-card recipe: a split frame with left-aligned name, role and episode topic on a brand panel while the speaker stays visible on the right, to open an interview or podcast clip.

- Type: Interview speaker card
- Skill: `magnifito-broll`
- Engine: `hyperframes`
- Output: 1920x1080, 6 s, with audio
- Video: [`../videos/s10-interview-speaker-card.mp4`](../videos/s10-interview-speaker-card.mp4)
- Footage: synthetic, generated by the commands below. No camera footage is used.

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> I have a talking-head clip (synthetic here: make it with node make-footage.mjs, presenter on the right half). Add an interview speaker card in the interview-speaker-card style for 4.5 seconds near the start: kicker "The Magnifito podcast", name "Mira", role "Social media lead, Magnifito", topic "Episode 3: Posting with a plan". The presenter is fictional, so record the name and role in claims.json as placeholders. Render the card transparent and lay it over the footage. Logo on the panel (assets/magnifito-logo.svg). Brand: cream panel, warm browns, dark ink, green #8acf31 accent, Geist from fonts/.

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- s10-interview-speaker-card
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/s10-interview-speaker-card/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
node make-footage.mjs 6 1440 left
mgvideo render . --codec mov_prores --force
node collect-run.mjs runs work/overlay.mov
ffmpeg -i work/source.mp4 -itsoffset 0.75 -i work/overlay.mov -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v]overlay=eof_action=pass:format=auto,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -map 0:a -t 6 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/interview-speaker-card.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/interview-speaker-card.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
